segments.text: This is my morning routine as someone trying to achieve immortality by 2039. I wake up naturally around 5:30 every morning. The first thing I do is get light in the eyes, set my circadian rhythm. Then I put in my eye drops, brush my teeth, water pick, and tongue scrape. I wear my red light cap for 6 minutes to stimulate hair growth. I head down and wake up Kitara. Then I make breakfast, which is the same thing every day. I'll put the details on the screen.

I take my morning pills with longevity mix, and then I'm off to the park to run with Kitara. This is a new part of my daily routine, which I really like. Then I'm back home for a workout. I'm training to dunk a basketball. I then sauna for 20 minutes at 200° F. I shower and then drink 20 oz of water with blueprint electrolytes. And then I'll do 40 minutes of IHHT. We are retesting this protocol. I have a breakdown video coming soon. After that, I do some quick skin care and then prep lunch for Kitara and me. Then I start the work day and I'll work about 9 hours. And that's my morning routine as someone who's trying to live forever.
